title: Add .gitignore with standard exclusions
description: Create a .gitignore file at the project root with standard Node.js exclusions plus project-specific entries to prevent compiled output, environment files, and system files from being committed.

steps.details:
Create .gitignore with the following entries on separate lines:
node_modules/
dist/
.env
.env.local
*.log
.DS_Store
coverage/
*.db
*.sqlite
Run `git status` and confirm that node_modules/ (if it exists) is not shown as an untracked file. If git is not yet initialized, run `git init` first.

technicalNotes: Add *.db and *.sqlite to prevent any SQLite test databases from being committed
.env.local is used by some frameworks for local-only env overrides
